chapter_list.desc: In The Great and Powerful Genie Episode 1, Steven Parrish reminisces his first encounter with Elijah Baran, the genie in a magic lamp who fulfilled everything he wanted. Decades later, he’s one of the richest men in the city, and he summons Elijah one last time to free him. The cost? He needs to marry his grandchild for five years and take care of her with all his heart.

At Steven’s funeral, Elijah introduces himself as the man Christine needs to marry to take full control of the Parrish’s estate. The Great and Powerful Genie Episode 2 seals their fates and Elijah fulfills his role as an obedient husband. Time flies so fast that Elijah’s contract is only shy away for several days. Still nothing has changed. Christime remains as ruthless as the first day.

To help Christine close the Hiller deal, Elijah seeks an audience with an old friend in The Great and Powerful Genie Episode 3. It’s Adrian Hiller, a man who once asked for his help, too. It’s time to ask for a favor and as he does, he relieves him from his deadly disease. Adrian then agrees to help the Parrish. Will this encounter help Elijah in the future?

The Great and Powerful Genie Episode 4 sheds light on Elijah’s genuine devotion to Christine. He buys her a gift for her upcoming birthday. When he gets home, he’s surprised to see a full-blown party where Christine’s friends gather to mock him. Elijah ignores them, only to face disappointment when Tony Roth, Christine’s ex, arrives and steals the scene.

Shocked at his arrival, Christine unknowingly drops Elijah’s gift after Tony shows his diamond necklace in The Great and Powerful Genie Episode 5. A mean girl purposefully drops the box in the pool, and Christine doesn’t even say anything. He dives straight into the cold water and retrieves his gift. Instead of questioning Tony’s involvement, he walks away in silence.

Christine’s disrespect and neglect continue in The Great and Powerful Genie Episode 6. Elijah admits the truth about securing the Hiller deal, but instead of acknowledging it, Christine belittles him. Her mother dismisses Elijah and orders him to drive her to the salon. He almost refuses to submit, especially when Tony shows up and locks himself with Christine inside the office. How far can Elijah take any more mockery?

To ease his mind, Elijah does his night routine in The Great and Powerful Genie Episode 7. He hand-picks a bouquet, cooks a nice dinner, and prepares Christine’s hot bath. Only for each effort to receive less attention when she comes home in a sour mood. To make it worse, he catches her moaning Tony’s name as she pleasures herself.

Elijah walks in the bathroom and hands her towel. His silence triggers Christine to start an argument in The Great and Powerful Genie Episode 8. She accuses Elijah of being a gold digger. Elijah fires back with compassion and assurance that in the next days, her wish will come true. For some reason, it bothers Christine to see him leaving.

Adrian’s grandson visits Christine in The Great and Powerful Genie Episode 9 and within minutes, they close the deal without any conflicts. Thinking Tony’s behind it, she instructs Elijah to drive her to Maple Hotel to meet up with her ex. Elijah stays mum, watching as she comes up to Tony’s room, clueless of the danger inside. Follow the next episodes to find out!

Elijah Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Elijah freedom, but on one condition, Elijah must marry his granddaughter, Christine, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Elijah transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Elijah starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. He decides to divorce her.
